task_definition.instruction_en: In a fixed robotic workspace, generate a rigid, physically consistent embodied robotic arm. The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to Grasp the medium-sized bowl for holding food, then use the arm to align and stack the bowl with shiny texture.
task_definition.instruction_zh: 在固定的机器人工作空间中，生成刚性的、物理一致的具体机器人手臂。手臂保持高稳定性，不变形，进入框架抓取中型碗盛放食物，然后用手臂将碗对齐并堆叠，质感闪亮。
